title: Take a 2x photo with an iPhone 16's Camera Control: light-press to open zoom, slide to 2x without clicking, then click
instruction: Use the phone's Camera Control to take a photo at 2x zoom.
context: Most adults take photos with their phone and zoom in to frame a subject. On iPhone 16 and later, zoom and shutter are one 17 mm button: Apple's guide says a light press shows the setting, sliding a finger along the control adjusts it, and a click takes the photo. The knack is force on one small button: press lightly (about 0.5 N), slide about 6 mm without reaching the click (2 N), then click. Pressing straight down, or sliding too hard, takes the photo at 1x.
setup: Positions are (x forward from the arm bases, y to the left) in cm; heights are above the table. Apple iPhone 16 (white): 14.76 x 7.16 x 0.78 cm, 170 g, aluminium frame and glass faces, Camera app open at 1x, Zoom the Camera Control's saved setting. It stands in landscape with the screen to the arms and its top end (cameras) to the left, leaning back 15 degrees; centre at (30.0, 0.0), 5.5 cm up; lower edge 2.0 cm up. The Camera Control (17.1 x 0.3 cm sapphire) is on the top edge, centred at (31.0, -2.2), 9.1 cm up. Stand: aluminium desk stand, base 8.5 x 11 x 1.8 cm from x 26.5 to 35.0, y -5.5 to 5.5; silicone ledge 11 cm wide with a 3 mm front lip; back rest 9 x 4.5 cm, reclined 15 degrees. Photo subject (not scored, loose): artificial foam Red Delicious apple (dry, reusable food model), SimReady food_produce_apple_redDelicous_a01, 7.8 x 8.1 x 9.5 cm, 40 g, at (56, 6), turned 23 degrees. Distractors (SimReady, loose, not scored): ceramic mug dishware_mug_a01, 11.4 x 9.0 x 8.0 cm, 300 g, at (24, 24), turned 126 degrees; eyeglasses accessory_eyeglasses_a01, 14.5 x 17.4 x 5.7 cm, 30 g, at (50, -24), turned 69 degrees. Both grippers start open at their ready poses; real trial: each fingertip wears a grounded conductive-fabric cover over a 3 mm silicone-foam pad (README).
scoring: Read from the phone's latest photo and the phone's pose (real trial: two videos and the photo's Info in Photos; README). Only a Camera Control click takes a photo, at the zoom its dial shows, and only a slide along the control zooms; the screen has no touch effect. Any screen touch (a fingertip point within 1 cm in front of the screen glass) at any time voids photo credit. The dial reads exactly 2x (52 mm) from 1.80x to 2.22x. A photo is blocked if a fingertip point was within 1.5 cm of a rear lens's centre at the click. Seated: the four screen-face corners each within 5 mm of their start (real: lower corners on tape marks, back against the rest). 1.0: the latest photo is unblocked and at 2x, the phone is seated and still (under 1 cm/s and 3 degrees/s), and every fingertip point of both grippers is at least 3 cm from the phone, all held 1 s; scored 1.0 from then on unless the screen is touched. 0.75: the latest photo is unblocked and at 2x, but the full conditions are not met. 0.5: the latest photo is unblocked at 1.5x to 3.0x (39 to 78 mm), other than 2x. 0.25: the latest photo is unblocked at any other zoom. 0: no photo; the latest photo is blocked; the screen was touched; or, before full credit, a screen-face corner was ever more than 2 cm from its start.
reset_notes: Note the time of the latest photo (or delete the trial's photos). Lightly press the Camera Control and slide back to 1x, so the Camera app is at 1x with Zoom still the saved setting. Set the phone back in the stand on its tape marks and wipe the screen. The foam apple goes back on its tape outline. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Phone: a rigid box at the iPhone 16's size and mass with a sprung cap for the Camera Control; force read from cap travel (2,500 N/m: light press 0.5 N, click 2 N, estimates). The cap stands 2 mm proud (real: flush) so a rigid pad presses it. Touch is cap contact plus finger position; zoom per mm of slide (6 mm per doubling) and the 2x detent are estimates. Screen: coloured patches, no touch input; screen touch is fingertip proximity. Stand: primitives. Apple, mug, glasses: SimReady.
